correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the common symmetric two-state trap trajectory makes X_i,X_j conditionally independent centered Gaussian for i!=j; hence covariance of their squares at separated times equals Cov(Y_0,Y_h) of the common conditional variance Y. For kappa>delta>0, Y obeys dot Y=2D-2(kappa+delta*sigma)Y. The two-state generator closes the relevant moments to C_second+(4kappa+2r)C_prime+4BC=F e^{-2rh}, C(0)=V,C_prime(0)=0, with positive F and V. Factorization yields rates a_+/-=2kappa+r +/- sqrt(r^2+4delta^2) and trap pole 2r. Since C_prime(0)=0 and C_second(0)=-(4BV-F)<0, the positive Green kernel gives C_prime(h)<0 for all h>0 and C(h)>0 by decay to zero. Unique slow crossing a_-=2r iff r=(kappa^2-delta^2)/kappa; at this point the forced Laplace pole is genuinely double with positive coefficient F/(a_+-2r), yielding h exp(-2rh), not canceled. Independent numerical 2-state moment matrix propagation and scalar forced ODE agree for r below, at and above 0.84 when kappa=1,delta=.4. All limits apply to finite N>=2, distinct labels, strict positive stiffnesses.
